item.title: 7kolor Signals — W34 周报 / Weekly Report
item.description: AI 编程从「万能」到「不可靠」的共识正在形成；定价策略成为获客开关；合规成本上升为隐性威胁。Consensus forms that AI coding is unreliable; pricing as the acquisition switch; compliance costs rising.
